#controls div{gap:16px}
#controls button{width:72px;height:72px;padding:0;border:3px solid #c8c9b1;border-bottom-width:3px;border-radius:15px;background:#17211bd9;color:#d4d9c7;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #303c33,0 3px 5px #0005;font-size:0;display:grid;place-items:center}

#controls button.jump{border-radius:50%;width:76px;height:76px}
#controls button.jump::before{transform:rotate(-90deg)}

#controls{bottom:max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left));right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}#controls div{gap:20px}#controls button{width:82px;height:82px;border-color:#d9dbc8;background:#14221ce0}#controls button.jump{width:88px;height:88px}#controls button::before{width:42px;height:42px}@media(max-height:430px){#controls{bottom:14px;left:18px;right:18px}#controls button{width:68px;height:68px}#controls button.jump{width:74px;height:74px}#controls button::before{width:36px;height:36px}}
:root{--control-size:82px;--control-gap:28px;--left-lift:24px;--side-offset:24px;--hud-scale:1;--arrow-size:41px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
#creditsPanel{max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto}#creditsPanel p{line-height:1.45;font-size:14px}.victorySummary{white-space:pre-line;color:#f4d38d;border-block:1px solid #b4985b;padding:12px}
#overlay{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d1d2caf,#0f213f66,#0d1d2caf);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.panel{border-radius:16px;border:3px double #cfaf67;background:#142632ed;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #493c2580,0 16px 50px #0007}
#menuPanel{max-width:470px;padding:25px 30px}#menuTitle{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#f7d58c;text-shadow:0 2px #754818,0 4px 0 #13232d;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,49px);margin:5px 0 8px}
.menuLead{color:#d8c89e;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0 20px}
.versionLabel{font-size:12px;color:#b9c9cd;margin:0 0 17px}#buildLabel{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:10px;color:#fff4d9ba;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #17313d;pointer-events:none}.controlPreview{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:var(--control-gap);padding:14px 12px 22px;min-height:110px}.controlPreview span{width:var(--control-size);height:var(--control-size);border:3px solid #d3d9bb;border-radius:18px;background:#1b383da8;color:#d3d9bb;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:var(--arrow-size)}
#mainButtons{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;max-width:310px;margin:auto}
#mainButtons button{border:3px double #e9c274;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(#f3e0b3,#d7b87b);color:#382a1e;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:22px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 4px #56422b;min-height:50px}
#mainButtons button:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8ed8ff;outline-offset:3px}
#homeMenu{margin-top:16px;background:transparent;border:1px solid #d9c18a;color:#eedab0}
.settingsPanel{max-width:850px;width:94%;padding:18px;max-height:94vh;overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.settingsHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.settingsHeader h2{margin:0;color:#f2d797;font-family:Georgia,serif}.settingsHeader button{padding:9px 18px}
#settingsTabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #b7995860;padding-bottom:12px}#settingsTabs button{font-size:13px;padding:9px 12px;min-height:40px;border-radius:8px;border-bottom-width:2px}#settingsTabs .selected{background:#d8bc7c;color:#302920;border-color:#fae2a6}
.settingsBody{max-height:65vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 12px 16px 0;touch-action:pan-y}.settingsTab h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#f3dba2;margin:5px 0 15px}.settingsTab p{line-height:1.45;font-size:14px}
.rangeLabel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;margin:17px 0;font-size:14px}.rangeLabel input{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;accent-color:#e6bd65;min-height:28px}.rangeLabel output{color:#efcf90;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.checkLabel{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:18px 0;font-size:14px;min-height:30px}.checkLabel input{width:21px;height:21px;accent-color:#d7b778}.presetRow{display:flex;gap:10px}.presetRow button{padding:8px 18px}.settingNote{color:#b6c1c7;font-size:12px!important}.settingsColumns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:25px}.selectLabel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}select{padding:10px;background:#253e48;color:#fff4d6;border:1px solid #e1c890;border-radius:7px}
.tutorialCards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.tutorialCards article{background:#243e4733;border:1px solid #a28f6255;border-radius:10px;padding:12px}.tutorialCards h4{color:#f3dba2;margin:0 0 10px}
.achievementRow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px 1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:13px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #bcc5c325;font-size:14px}.achievementRow p{margin:3px 0;font-size:12px;color:#bdc9ce}.achievementRow.unlocked{background:#38533a35}.achievementMark{font-size:23px}.achievementStatus{color:#f0cf89;font-size:12px}.achievementRow:not(.unlocked) .achievementMark{opacity:.4}
#options{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}#options button{font-size:13px;padding:10px 12px}#grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(10,minmax(0,1fr))}
#toast{position:absolute;top:88px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 18px;border:2px solid #dec17c;background:#162d39ed;border-radius:12px;text-align:center;z-index:8;font-size:14px;pointer-events:none;max-width:85%;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0005}
#hud{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}#hud>span{font-size:calc(14px * var(--hud-scale));padding:calc(7px * var(--hud-scale)) calc(10px * var(--hud-scale))}#hud button{font-size:calc(15px * var(--hud-scale));padding:calc(7px * var(--hud-scale)) calc(11px * var(--hud-scale))}.compactHud #hud>span{padding:5px 7px;font-size:calc(12px * var(--hud-scale))}.compactHud #hud button{padding:5px 8px;font-size:calc(13px * var(--hud-scale))}
#bossProgress{position:absolute;top:58px;left:25%;right:25%;height:17px;background:#182830c9;border:1px solid #b0c7b1;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}#bossFill{height:100%;width:0;background:#68bd69;transition:width .12s linear}#bossText{position:absolute;inset:0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;line-height:15px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px #163e27}
#controls{bottom:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:max(var(--side-offset),env(safe-area-inset-left));right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}#controls div{gap:var(--control-gap);transform:translateY(calc(-1 * var(--left-lift)))}#controls button{width:var(--control-size);height:var(--control-size)}#controls button.jump{width:88px;height:88px}#controls button::before{width:var(--arrow-size);height:var(--arrow-size)}
#controls button.pressed{filter:brightness(1.22);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px #0005}
@media(max-height:430px){#menuPanel{padding:14px 24px;max-width:430px}#menuTitle{font-size:28px}#mainButtons{gap:9px}#mainButtons button{min-height:43px;padding:8px;font-size:18px}.menuLead{margin:5px 0 10px}.settingsPanel{padding:12px;max-height:96vh}.settingsBody{max-height:58vh}#settingsTabs{margin:10px 0;padding-bottom:8px;gap:5px}#settingsTabs button{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px;min-height:36px}.rangeLabel{margin:11px 0}#controls{bottom:16px}#controls button.jump{width:74px;height:74px}#toast{top:62px}#bossProgress{top:49px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.settingsColumns,.tutorialCards{grid-template-columns:1fr}#grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.ending #hud,.ending #controls,.ending #bossProgress,.ending #tip,.ending #buildLabel,.ending #toast{display:none!important}.ending #overlay{background:transparent;backdrop-filter:none}
#creditsPanel.endingCredits{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#0d1c28bf;box-shadow:none;overflow:hidden;text-align:center}
#creditsContent{position:absolute;left:10%;right:10%;top:0;animation:creditsRoll 42s linear forwards}#creditsContent h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#f3d294;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,40px);letter-spacing:3px}#creditsContent p{font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,20px);line-height:1.6;margin:38px 0;color:#e5e3cf}#creditsContent .victorySummary{color:#f0cf86;border:0}#creditsBack{position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:12px 25px;z-index:2}
@keyframes creditsRoll{from{transform:translateY(100vh)}to{transform:translateY(-100%)}}

#qualityPreview{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:760/300;margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #b9c9c355;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#203745}
.lowQuality #game,.lowQuality #qualityPreview,.lowQuality #tutorialCanvas{image-rendering:pixelated}
#tutorialCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:12/5;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#203745}
.tutorialToolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;margin:12px 0 4px}.tutorialToolbar button{padding:7px 11px;min-width:42px;min-height:40px;border-radius:9px;font-size:19px}.tutorialDots{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.tutorialDots button{font-size:17px;padding:5px 9px;min-width:34px}.tutorialDots button[aria-current="true"]{background:#dcbd7e;color:#243440;border-color:#ffe6a7}
#controls button,.controlPreview span{border:3px solid #7996a4;border-bottom:5px solid #526b7c;border-radius:23%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#24465be8,#183447e8);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 #bcced52b,0 4px 0 #10233265;color:#f4f3df;width:var(--control-width);height:var(--control-size)}
#controls button::before,.controlPreview i{display:block;content:"";width:var(--arrow-size);height:var(--arrow-size);background:#f4f3df;clip-path:polygon(20% 10%,90% 50%,20% 90%,25% 50%)}
.controlPreview .previewLeft i{transform:rotate(180deg)}#controls button.jump{border-radius:23%}#controls button.pressed{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#426a83,#24485f);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px #10233290,0 2px 0 #10233265;border-color:#a8c4d0}
#controls button.jump{width:var(--jump-size);height:var(--jump-size)}
#buildLabel{left:auto;right:8px;bottom:6px;transform:none;font-size:9px}#versionLabel{display:none;position:absolute;right:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));margin:0;pointer-events:none}
.lowQuality #controls button,.lowQuality .controlPreview span{background:#1c3d51;box-shadow:0 3px #10233265}
#menuArtwork{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;pointer-events:none}
.homeScreen #overlay{background:#1b3447;backdrop-filter:none}.homeScreen #menuArtwork{display:block}.homeScreen #hud,.homeScreen #controls,.homeScreen #tip,.homeScreen #buildLabel,.homeScreen #bossProgress{display:none!important}
.homeScreen #menuPanel{position:absolute;left:50%;top:42%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:34%;max-width:360px;padding:0;background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible;max-height:none}.homeScreen #menuTitle{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}.homeScreen #mainButtons{max-width:none;gap:11px}.homeScreen #mainButtons button{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(#f8e5bc,#e9d098 65%,#e0b974);border:4px double #9a651b;border-radius:23px;font-size:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px);min-height:46px;padding:8px 14px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e9be62,0 4px #5b351e,0 7px 15px #182d3c66;font-weight:700}.homeScreen #mainButtons button::before,.homeScreen #mainButtons button::after{content:"◆";position:absolute;color:#a27529;font-size:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}.homeScreen #mainButtons button::before{left:11px}.homeScreen #mainButtons button::after{right:11px}.homeScreen #versionLabel{display:block;padding:0;background:none;color:#fff2d7;font-size:9px;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #172c40}.homeScreen #stats{color:#f6e2b2;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #142735;font-size:14px;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-height:430px){.homeScreen #menuPanel{top:42%;width:35%;max-width:300px}.homeScreen #mainButtons{gap:9px}.homeScreen #mainButtons button{min-height:34px;padding:5px 13px;font-size:18px;border-width:3px}.homeScreen #versionLabel{font-size:9px}.tutorialToolbar{gap:6px;margin-top:9px}.tutorialToolbar button{min-height:36px;min-width:34px;padding:5px 8px}.tutorialDots{gap:4px}.tutorialDots button{min-width:30px;padding:4px 7px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.tutorialToolbar{flex-wrap:wrap}.tutorialDots{order:3;width:100%}}

#controls,#controlEditArea{position:absolute;inset:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left));display:block;pointer-events:none}
#controls div{display:contents;transform:none}
#controls button,#controlEditArea button{position:absolute;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none}
#controlEditor{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:15;background:#12283c35;touch-action:none}
#controlEditArea button{border:3px solid #7996a4;border-bottom:5px solid #526b7c;border-radius:23%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#24465be8,#183447e8);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 #bcced52b,0 4px 0 #10233265;font-size:0}
#controlEditArea button::before{content:"";width:var(--arrow-size);height:var(--arrow-size);background:#f4f3df;clip-path:polygon(20% 10%,90% 50%,20% 90%,25% 50%)}
#edit-left::before{transform:rotate(180deg)}#edit-jump::before{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
#controlEditArea button.selected{outline:3px solid #f5d68a;outline-offset:4px}
#controlEditorToolbar{position:absolute;top:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(580px,94%);padding:10px 14px;border:2px solid #d2b675;border-radius:14px;background:#132b3def;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0005;text-align:center}
#controlEditorToolbar p{margin:2px 0 8px;font-size:13px;color:#eddbb5}.controlEditorRow{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:7px}.controlEditorRow button{font-size:12px;padding:6px 12px;min-height:32px;border-radius:8px}.controlEditorRow button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#d5b572;color:#142b3c}.controlEditorRow input{width:min(210px,40vw);accent-color:#dfbd76}.controlEditorRow label,.controlEditorRow output{font-size:12px}.editingControls #hud,.editingControls #controls,.editingControls #tip,.editingControls #bossProgress{display:none!important}
#menuArtwork{image-rendering:auto;filter:none}
#toggleControlToolbar{position:absolute;top:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-right));width:40px;height:40px;padding:0;font-size:20px;z-index:1;background:#132b3def}

html,body{touch-action:manipulation}#game,#controls button{touch-action:none}#overlay{touch-action:pan-y}

#qualitySetting{font:inherit;background:#e7d7b4;color:#233747;border:2px solid #9d885d;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;width:100%;margin-top:10px}#achievementList{content-visibility:auto}
/* Lightweight touch controls: identical geometry in game and editor. */
#controls button,#controls button.jump,#controlEditArea button,.controlPreview span{
 border:1.5px solid #b7d1dbb8;border-bottom:3px solid #5c7d91;border-radius:19px;
 background:linear-gradient(155deg,#254859e8,#102b3de8);color:#fff7df;
 box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff38,inset 0 -3px 7px #081a3030,0 3px 7px #071d3540;
 transition:background 80ms,border-color 80ms,box-shadow 80ms;
}
#controls button::before,#controlEditArea button::before,.controlPreview i{
 background:#fff6dd;clip-path:polygon(28% 13%,82% 50%,28% 87%,35% 50%);
}
#controls button.pressed,#controlEditArea button:active{
 background:linear-gradient(155deg,#50788aee,#24465cee);border-color:#f6db9d;
 box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px #061d3a65,0 1px 3px #071d3530;
}

/* Center icons independently of padding and old button styles. */
#controls button,#controlEditArea button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0!important;box-sizing:border-box;line-height:1;font-size:0}
#controls button::before,#controlEditArea button::before,.controlPreview i{margin:0;flex:none;width:36%;height:36%;clip-path:polygon(22% 10%,88% 50%,22% 90%);transform-origin:50% 50%}
#controls button[data-control="left"]::before,#edit-left::before{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#controls button[data-control="right"]::before,#edit-right::before{transform:none}
#controls button[data-control="jump"]::before,#edit-jump::before{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.compactHud #audio,.compactHud #retry,.compactHud #hudOptions,.compactHud #timeHud,.compactHud #deaths{display:none!important}
.compactHud #pause{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;font-size:22px;padding:0}

/* Small landscape devices keep the demonstration and navigation in one view. */
#tutorialSettings{min-height:0;text-align:center}
#tutorialCanvas{display:block;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;max-width:100%;max-height:calc(100dvh - 220px);aspect-ratio:12/5;margin:0 auto;border-radius:12px}
.tutorialToolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.tutorialToolbar button{min-width:32px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 8px}
#effect{font-size:clamp(10px,1.45vw,15px);max-width:60vw;white-space:normal;line-height:1.25}
#toast{pointer-events:none;max-width:min(80vw,520px);font-size:clamp(13px,2vw,19px)}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:460px){
 #settingsPanel{padding:10px 16px!important;max-height:96dvh}
 #settingsPanel h2{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 5px}
 #settingsPanel .panelHeader{margin-bottom:4px}
 #tutorialCanvas{max-height:calc(100dvh - 200px)}
 .tutorialToolbar{margin-top:4px;gap:4px}
 .tutorialDots{gap:3px!important}
 .tutorialToolbar button{min-height:28px;min-width:28px;padding:3px 6px}
}

#tutorialCaption{font-size:clamp(11px,1.6vw,15px);line-height:1.3;margin:5px 0;color:#e5e6d7}

#toast:not([hidden]){animation:mechanicNotice 3.2s ease both}@keyframes mechanicNotice{0%{opacity:0}9%,82%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}

body.tutorialOpen .settingsBody{max-height:none!important;overflow:visible!important}

#entryScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#122a3c;color:#fff3d6;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
#entryScreen[hidden]{display:none!important}#entryArtwork{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;z-index:-2}#entryScreen::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 32%,#10203450 62%,#0b182bee);z-index:-1}
.entryContent{position:absolute;top:59%;text-align:center;max-width:90vw}.entryContent p{margin:0 0 20px;font:italic clamp(14px,2vw,22px) Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}
#enterGame{min-height:52px;padding:12px 36px;border:3px double #b1843b;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(#fff0cb,#d8b269);color:#34230d;font:700 clamp(18px,2.6vw,27px) Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #60461f,0 8px 25px #0006;touch-action:manipulation}
#enterGame:active{transform:translateY(2px)}#entryScreen small{position:absolute;bottom:14px;right:16px;font-size:10px;opacity:.8}
.tutorialChoose{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:4px 0 8px}#tutorialStepLabel{color:#f1d397;font-size:14px}#tutorialTopic{min-height:34px;max-width:52%;border:1px solid #a38b61;background:#173745;color:#fff1d0;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:14px}
body.tutorialOpen #tutorialCanvas{max-height:calc(100dvh - 220px);border:1px solid #ba9e6655}body.tutorialOpen .tutorialDots{display:none}body.tutorialOpen .tutorialToolbar{flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:12px}body.tutorialOpen .tutorialToolbar button{font-size:14px;padding:7px 13px;min-height:34px}body.tutorialOpen #tutorialPlay{min-width:44px;font-size:18px}body.tutorialOpen #tutorialCaption{min-height:1.3em;margin:6px 0}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:460px){body.tutorialOpen #tutorialCanvas{max-height:calc(100dvh - 195px)}.tutorialChoose{margin:0 0 4px}#tutorialTopic{min-height:28px;font-size:12px}#tutorialStepLabel{font-size:12px}body.tutorialOpen .tutorialToolbar button{min-height:29px;padding:4px 10px}.entryContent p{margin-bottom:10px}#enterGame{min-height:43px;padding:8px 25px}}
@media(orientation:portrait){.homeScreen #menuPanel{top:43%;width:76%;max-width:360px}.homeScreen #mainButtons button{min-height:46px}.homeScreen #menuArtwork,#entryArtwork{object-position:center top}.entryContent{top:60%}#tutorialCanvas{max-width:100%}#tutorialStepLabel{font-size:12px}}

#updateNotice[hidden]{display:none!important}#updateNotice{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1100;background:#081725dc;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px}#updateNotice>div{max-width:480px;max-height:85dvh;overflow:auto;padding:24px;background:#203646;color:#f3e4c8;border:2px solid #c8a05c;border-radius:16px;text-align:center}#updateNotice p{line-height:1.5}#ackUpdate{min-height:46px;padding:10px 28px;border-radius:10px;background:#edce92;color:#253444;font-weight:bold}
#loadingScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1200;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:#102638;color:#fff0ce;text-align:center;transition:opacity .28s ease}
#loadingScreen[hidden]{display:none!important}#loadingScreen.done{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#loadingArtwork{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:brightness(.55);z-index:-1}
.loadingContent{width:min(540px,85vw);padding:24px;background:linear-gradient(#10263800,#102638ce);border-radius:22px}
.loadingCrown{font-size:36px;color:#edc97b}.loadingContent h1{font:700 clamp(30px,6vw,58px) Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:8px 0;color:#ffe2a3;text-shadow:0 3px 8px #001}
.loadingTranslation{font:italic clamp(16px,2.4vw,24px) Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 14px}.loadingJourney{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 25px;color:#e7dcc3}
.loadingTrack{height:8px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #e5c47680;border-radius:9px;background:#10263880}.loadingTrack span{display:block;width:0%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ad843d,#ffe0a0);transition:width .2s}
#loadingStatus{font-size:12px;margin:10px 0 0;color:#eadfc8}
/* Keep the world visible beneath controls, in every quality and pressed state. */
#controls button,.lowQuality #controls button{background:rgba(20,45,62,.18);border-color:#c4d9e455;border-bottom-color:#c4d9e455;box-shadow:none;backdrop-filter:none;transition:background .1s,border-color .1s}
#controls button.pressed,.lowQuality #controls button.pressed{background:rgba(44,83,108,.30);border-color:#e5f2d78c;box-shadow:none}
#controls button::before{background:#f4f3dfe0;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #102638)}
@media(max-height:430px){.loadingContent{padding:12px}.loadingCrown{font-size:24px}.loadingContent h1{font-size:32px}.loadingJourney{margin-bottom:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#loadingScreen,.loadingTrack span,#controls button{transition:none}}
